title: One-pot native barcoding of amplicons
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbnmimc6

steps.title: Prepare End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the following reaction for each sample in a tube:

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL DNA amplicons
Add 7.5 µL Nuclease-free water
Add 1.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer
Add 0.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Total volume: 15 µL)
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 minutes
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Perform Native Barcoding
steps.instruction: Add the following components directly to the previous reactions, using one native barcode from EXP-NBD104 (1-12) or EXP-NBD114 (13-24) per sample (use 6 to 24 barcodes per library):

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL NBXX barcode
Add 17.5 µL Ultra II Ligation Master Mix
Add 0.5 µL Ligation Enhancer (Total volume: 35.5 µL)

steps.title: Incubate Barcoding Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the following incubation sequence to ligate and inactivate the ligase:

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes
Incubate at 70 °C for 10 minutes
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Pool and Clean-up Amplicons
steps.instruction: Pool all barcoded fragments into a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and perform amplicon clean-up using SPRI beads.

steps.title: Quantify Barcoded Pools
steps.instruction: Quantify the barcoded amplicon pools using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay.

steps.title: Set up AMII Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Set up the ligation reaction using 40 ng (for 8 barcodes) to 160 ng (for 24 barcodes) of barcoded amplicon pools:

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL Barcoded amplicon pools
Add 10 µL NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (5X)
Add 5 µL AMII adapter mix
Add 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase (Total volume: 50 µL)

steps.title: Incubate Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Perform First SPRI Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to SPRI beads:

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRI beads thoroughly until the solution is a homogenous brown colour
Add 50 µL (1:1) of SPRI beads to the sample tube and mix gently by flicking or pipetting
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature
Place on magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes or until beads have pelleted and supernatant is clear
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant without touching the bead pellet

steps.title: Perform First SFB Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads to remove excess adapter:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Remove and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Perform Second SFB Wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the SFB wash process to ensure purity:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Remove and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Elute Final Library
steps.instruction: Elute the final DNA library from the beads:

substeps.instruction: Pulse centrifuge and remove any residual SFB (do not air dry)
Add 15 µL EB and resuspend beads by pipette mixing
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes
Place on magnetic rack
Transfer final library to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube
